baseline: Off, from runs that already exist, read with raread.py over the same window (mark-2 .. mark+1.5 s, the countdown; 12 starts each, plain build at 07937793af, which runs master's race-start code since perdraw1009's switches are default-off): 1-1791649039-nfsframe1010-2037292 cold 56.3 ms, warm 41.4 ms (v2 54% v3 43% v4 2%); 1-1791649724-nfsframe1010-2219502 cold 58.5 ms, warm 40.2 ms (v2 52% v3 41% v4 1%); pooled cold 57.4 (2 lines), warm 40.7 (31 lines), v2 53%. Frametrace (nfs30plan1010 1-1791649387, 1-1791649388, NOTES 5.5): the PFIFO thread blocks 6.7 ms/frame cold and 4.3 ms/frame warm at p_fence (#54) inside pgraph_vk_process_pending_reports_internal, once per frame, under pfifo.lock.
prediction: #433 HAKUX_REPORT_ASYNC=1 at the NFS MW race start. With the switch on, the finish hands the occlusion reports to a reader thread and returns without waiting on any fence; the reader waits for the frame slot's own fence and writes the reports. The PFIFO thread, which paces the frame, loses the p_fence wait (4.3 ms/frame warm, 6.7 cold), and the guest's DMA_PUT store no longer queues behind it on pfifo.lock. Predicted, pooled over 2 runs per state, 12 starts each, pace lines printed in mark-2 .. mark+1.5 s: W: warm countdown period (starts 2-12) on <= 38.0 ms and on - off <= -2.5 ms (point estimate 40.7 -> 37 ms: most of the 4.3 ms is critical path, since the wait sits on the pacing thread and the GPU is not the limit at this scene); off inside [39, 44] (the baseline's band), else the arm is not the baseline. C: cold start 1 on <= 55.0 ms (point 57 -> 52; two pace lines per state, so loose), off inside [54, 64]. H: frames are VBLANK-quantized, so the gain shows as frames moving from 3 VBLANKs to 2: warm v2 share on - off >= +10 points (point 53% -> 65%). What refutes it: W and H fail with the build's '[reportasync] on' line present -- the wait was not on the critical path (the vCPU, not the PFIFO thread, sets the period) or it moved to another site (rule 3's gate, or the render thread), which the trace's gate= field on the pilot run names. Pixels: route frames at the 12 marks (s*-g11.png) on vs off, region by region: a report read before it was written shows as a car, a light or a flare missing or popping.
expect_note: Named rules read by docs/lanes/reportasync1010/raread.py --expect (legs V, W, C, H); a soak writes no captures. The frametrace confirmation (p_fence at #54 -> 0, one perflog run) is optional and not part of this verdict; the pilot's HAKUX_REPORT_TRACE run already counts the finishing thread's report waits (0 on, 4114 off, 1-1791656656 / 1-1791656657).
